main_text.l: prium est, participarent etiam in divinitate. Lege igi-
tur in textu, lin. 17. non [ essentiam suam scire ] sed
[per essentiam suam scire] Sic enim & quid per scire
لااتا intelligant docet nos Alsharestanins, ubi inter
عالم لااتا لا بعلم Scientem per essentiam suam non per
scientiam, & ذاته عالم بعلم هو ذاته per scientiam quæ ip-
sius essentia sit (quæ Abi Hodhaili Ahmedis forma
loquendi fuit) distinguit, quod scil. verba priora sint
نفي الصفة Negatio attributi, seu proprietatis, (ut &
loquitur Author noster) posteriora vero اثبات ذات

l.i: affirmatio essentiæ quæ ipsa sit attribu-

main_text.l: tum, vel اثبات صفة هي بعينها ذات affirmatio at-
tributi, quod ipsum sit essentia. Sed nec omnes qui for-
mam istā لااتا per essentiam suam usurpabant, eodem
modo illam intelligebant, eodem teste, qui Al Job-
baiensis sententiam sic explicat, quòd cùm diceret
Deum scire لاينقضي كونه عالما, hoc vellet, لا يقتضي كونه عالما

l.bl: هي علم اوحال يوجب كونه عالما

l.i: quòd sciens sit, attributum quod sit scientia, aut statum

main_text.l: qui necessarium faciat ut sit sciens. At ex Abi Al-
Hashemi ipsius filii, sententia, illud de Deo dictum,
innuere اذ وحالة هي صفة
معلومة ورا كونه ذاتا esse ipsi dispositionem [seu conditionem ] quæ
sit proprietas nota, posterior eo quod sit essentia existens,
atque ita in reliquis attributis: Porrò monet idem,
quæstionem istam de attributis Dei, sub initio fuisse
غير نضيجة nondum maturam, deinde verò à
Wasels sectatoribus post lectos Philosophorum libros, ad ma-
turitatem perductam.

page.notes: Arabic and Greek-style passages are reproduced as far as legible; the Arabic script is rendered loosely and several Arabic words are doubtful, so they should be checked against the scan. The Arabic lines within the Latin text are marked by their context only. Some Latin words in the first lines are faint. The catchword "Fogientes" is faint at the foot. Possible print-level doubts: "Alsharestanins" (al-Shahrastani), "Abi Hodhaili Ahmedis", "Al Jobbaiensis", "Abi Al-Hashemi", "Wasels" (Wāṣil) are copied as printed.
